title: Goal 2: Prepared Rename Failure and Recovery
error_detail: rename_int_overload: symbol locator resolved to 2 declarations
interpretation: The prepared rename could not proceed because the symbol locator 'Billing/quoteTotal' resolves to both the int and String overloads. Semantic refactoring requires explicit method signature or byte-range information to disambiguate.
recovery_method: Manual literal replacement using edit_apply kind=replace_literal with expected_count guards

recovery_details.operation_1: Replaced declaration: 'public static int quoteTotal(int units)' → 'public static int invoiceTotal(int units)'
